title: A reflective infographic exploring the tension between exceptional cognitive capacity and heightened emotional sensitivity. This piece examines deep systems thinking, emotional saturation, burnout vulnerability, and the challenge of holding intensity without being consumed by it. A reminder that sensitivity is not the opposite of strength—it is often part of what makes depth, creativity, and insight possible. #high-sensitivity #giftedness #personal-growth #nervous-system #self-awareness
